bio: Relax and indulge with an afternoon tea for two in gorgeous Devon. Best Western Tiverton Hotel is a delightful retreat offering easy access to the rural splendour of Exmoor National Park, the fascinating history of Exeter city centre and the beautiful beaches of the English Riviera.Â Â You'll be delighted as you tuck in to a delicious Devon afternoon tea for two in the hotel's stylish and award-winning restaurant, including a choice of tea or coffee, sandwiches, cakes and warm scones.
